name: North Macedonia
prevalence_note: MVR warnings 2025-2026: fake doctors after a traffic accident collecting cash, fake central bank staff asking for card data, fake post parcel fees, and crypto trading platforms.
cross_border_note: Cross-border callers (including regional Bulgarian and Balkan rings) spoof +389 bank or police numbers or contact victims via Viber and WhatsApp from +359, +381, +49, and +41 prefixes for fake traffic-accident and crypto scams.

scams.name: Лажен доктор: сообраќајна несреќа и пари во готово
scams.name_en: Fake doctor after a traffic accident
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a doctor says a relative was in a traffic accident and needs cash for implants or surgery; a man will come to the building to collect it.
scams.legit_en: Hospitals never collect cash from relatives in front of their building.
bait_tactics: Да каже дека не слуша добро и да побара да повтори во која болница е
Да праша како се вика докторот

scams.name: Лажна Народна банка: податоци од картичка
scams.name_en: Fake central bank asking for card data
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the central bank or a bank says the account is at risk and asks for the card number, PIN, the SMS security code or the personal ID number.
scams.legit_en: The central bank and banks never ask for card numbers, PINs or SMS codes by phone.
bait_tactics: Да каже дека апликацијата се ажурира и да побара да објасни уште еднаш
Да праша за која сума станува збор

scams.name: Лажна пошта: наплата за испорака
scams.signals_en: A caller or text from the post says a parcel has a wrong address and asks to pay a delivery fee through a link with card data and CVV.
scams.legit_en: The post never asks for card data or CVV through links or by phone.
bait_tactics: Да каже дека ги бара очилата и да праша од каде е пакетот

scams.name: Крипто платформа: брза заработка
scams.name_en: Crypto trading platform with quick earnings
scams.signals_en: A caller from an investment platform promises quick crypto earnings, asks to install AnyDesk and send an ID photo, then demands a commission before paying out.
scams.legit_en: Licensed brokers never ask for remote access or commissions before paying out.
bait_tactics: Да каже дека запишува и да праша колку е првата уплата
